question: Which planning conditions must be discharged before work starts?

sentences.text: Condition 5 must be discharged before development starts: it requires the Construction Traffic Management Plan to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

citation.quote: No development shall commence until a Construction Traffic Management Plan has been submitted

citations.heading: Condition 5: Construction traffic
citations.paragraph_text: No development shall commence until a Construction Traffic Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

sentences.text: No discharge of Condition 5 is on file, raised as RFI-02.
